summary.text: Patrick McAuley is the Republican nominee for Indiana's 7th Congressional District. As of this research, he had not completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey and no biography was found.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from North Central High School (2015), according to his BallotReady candidate profile.
Earned a bachelor's degree in religion from Wabash College (2020) and a master's degree in economics from Valparaiso University (2022), according to the same profile.

The profile lists work as a tennis professional at The Courts of Northwest Indiana (2020-2022) and an assistant tennis pro at the Jewish Community Center (2022-2023), a brokerage assistant at Douglas Realty Group (2022 to present), and an associate at Broad Ripple Capital Inc. (2024 to present).
Won the May 5, 2026 Republican primary for the 7th District and advanced to the general election against Rep. André Carson.
